goal: Best feasible half-marathon performance with controlled early pacing
schedule_note: Дни пробежек и отдыха указаны для каждой недели; воскресные недели с H заменяют пятничную работу, контрольная суббота заменяет обычный parkrun. Проверка дистанции каждой пробежки относительно предыдущих 30 дней имеет приоритет над ростом времени.
intensity: Garmin RUNNING %LTHR reference zones with talk test/RPE prescriptions; no fixed HR target for workouts; zone changes do not prescribe faster running

zone_configuration.source: Fresh Garmin settings snapshot retrieved 2026-10-05; LTHR estimate still dated 2026-08-05
zone_configuration.snapshot_note: Reference boundaries only; not lab-validated. Z5 floor 174 reflects integer rounding of the Garmin zone setting. E is governed by talk test/RPE, not numeric zone alone.
zone_configuration.easy_effort: RPE 2–3; full-sentence talk test, no minimum HR; 148–150 bpm is a temporary personal caution cue, not a target or hard physiological/safety cap; if talk test fails slow down
zone_configuration.steady_effort: S: RPE 3–4, below T; usually Z2 or low Z3 by effort; never force 155 bpm
zone_configuration.tempo_effort: T: controlled RPE 6–7; zone is contextual reference only, do not force 165–174 bpm
zone_configuration.half_marathon_effort: H: controlled RPE 5–6; validate by evenness and recovery, not a fixed pace forecast
zone_configuration.reassessment: Reassess the Garmin LTHR estimate around the 2026-12-05 control; include a fresh estimate and training response. A 5 km result alone does not measure LTHR.

rules.growth_condition: Add only the next scheduled step when all scheduled quality parts remain controlled, easy runs pass the talk test, the long run stays within its effort and rolling-30-day distance check, fatigue resolves normally within 48 hours, and there is no illness or new/increasing pain. Recovery/control weeks stay as planned; if not, repeat or reduce 10–15%; never catch up missed sessions.
rules.specific_long_effort: Updated upper Z3 / lower Z4 is provisional guidance; RPE5-6, stable long blocks; refine using block consistency, recovery and control races
rules.race_week_total_note: Totals exclude race and race warmup. Saturday commute on foot. Week1 totals are optional ceilings, not completion target.
rules.monday_distribution: Conversational E in weeks 3–5,7–9,11–12,14–15,17,19,21–22,24; R on other scheduled Mondays. After H-long weeks 17,19,22,24 the next Monday is R. Easy E is talk-test and RPE guided; if tired shorten or rest without compensation.
rules.winter_volume_review: После недели 19 оцени фактически выполненные недели, восстановление и качество тренировок, прежде чем рассматривать дополнительную позднюю ветку лёгких минут в неделях 21–22. Одна только дата не включает эту ветку.
rules.ordinary_training_week_base_ceiling_note: Conservative planning choice informed by six-month recorded weekly maximum 355 min in the 10 km cycle and 353.45 min in the half-marathon cycle; not a physiological ceiling. Optional late conditional branch may reach 375 min after review.
rules.distance_progression: Before each run, compare its expected distance with the longest single run in the rolling previous 30 days and check recovery; this overrides time-based progression. A distance jump over about 10% is an observational risk signal, not a safe/unsafe boundary. If the planned run is around 10% or more above recent longest, hold or reduce distance; smaller increases still require normal recovery and judgment.

entry_conditions: After week 19, at least 4 actual working weeks of 330–360 min in prior 6–8 calendar weeks (recovery/control weeks need not reach that volume)
Scheduled quality parts controlled, E passes full-sentence talk test, normal next-day recovery within 48 h

21.rule: Только после успешной оценки по условиям поздней ветки.

conditional_late_branch.description: Optional easy-minute additions only in weeks 21–22; planning ceiling 375 min, not a physiological ceiling. No extra T/H repetitions or intensity.
conditional_late_branch.activation: No date-based activation; use base plan if any condition is not met. The optional branch applies only to weeks 21–22.

volume_history.note: Recorded volume is not the same as the historical plan: 56.6 km was a planned HM week, not a recorded-minutes maximum.

rules.base_plan_ceiling_note: Пик базового плана в 360 минут — консервативный плановый выбор с учётом зарегистрированных максимумов циклов (355 минут в подготовке к 10 км 2026 года и 353,45 минуты в подготовке к полумарафону 2026 года), а не физиологический предел. Условная поздняя ветка недель 21–22 может довести объём до 375 минут после оценки восстановления и фактически выполненных тренировок.
rules.version_1_6_note: Пересмотр после v1.5: пороговая работа к неделе 5 достигает 18 минут, длительные недель 7–9 растут до 90/95/100 минут с обязательной проверкой фактической дистанции и восстановления; условная ветка ограничена неделями 21–22 и 375 минутами.
